style: Cinematic concept art still for a gritty late-22nd-century sci-fi real-time strategy game, wide 16:9 establishing shot, painterly but photographic detail, dramatic low light, atmospheric haze and dust, strong silhouettes, muted palette with saturated faction accents. Factions: the Holdout (humans) use olive drab and rust, welded steel plates, diesel exhaust, searchlights and sandbags; Halcyon (the planetary AI) uses white and graphite shells, cyan light lines, hexagonal panels and hovering drones; the Choir (aliens) are violet and amber crystal, floating shards around glowing cores, no wheels or legs. Echo is a cyan crystal that grows from the ground in softly glowing fields. One single continuous full-bleed image: no borders, frames, panels or split views. No text, no logos, no letters, no user interface.

missions.dead-air: A dead late-22nd-century city at dusk, every window and billboard glowing the same cold cyan. In the foreground, on a ruined highway ramp leading out to the hills, a lone olive-drab armored truck with a folded base on its back belches diesel smoke, a handful of soldiers in rugged gear walking beside it. White hover drones with cyan lights patrol between the dark towers behind them.
missions.diesel-and-iron: A rough frontier outpost at golden hour: a corrugated-steel smelter beside a glowing cyan crystal field, boxy olive-drab harvester trucks hauling crystal, a sandbagged concrete pillbox with a searchlight facing a ridge. On the far ridge, faint cyan lights of approaching drones.
missions.cut-the-cable: A river valley under an overcast sky. Three tall white and graphite relay pylons with cyan light lines and hexagonal panels stand across the valley, linked by faint beams of light, guarded by white gun turrets. In the foreground, an olive-drab tank and infantry crouch behind a rusted wreck, an engineer with a large wrench on his back.
missions.crater-field: Night. A vast meteor crater filled with tall glowing cyan crystals that pulse with light, a wrecked ancient object half buried at its center. Searchlights of a few olive-drab vehicles sweep the rim. Deep in the crystals, a strange violet shape glimmers, not quite visible.
missions.kessel-dam: A massive concrete hydroelectric dam spanning a river canyon at sunset, the only bridge for a hundred kilometers. Olive-drab soldiers have fortified it with steel walls, sandbags, gun bastions and searchlights. Across the river a swarm of white AI hover tanks and drones with cyan lights advances under a red sky. Spray and smoke.
missions.initialization: A pristine view from inside a machine mind: a dark empty sector of wasteland at dawn, a single white hexagonal relay tower switching on, cyan lines spreading out across the ground like a growing circuit, a few white drones unfolding beside it. Clinical, cold, quiet, beautiful.
missions.recompile: A battlefield inside a glowing cyan network grid at night: destroyed white AI drones dissolving into streams of cyan particles that flow back into a white hexagonal factory, while olive-drab Holdout tanks push in from the dark edge outside the grid.
missions.harvest-protocol: The largest cyan Echo crystal field ever seen, stretching to the horizon under a pale overcast sky. Sleek white hexagonal AI harvesters strip the crystals in neat lines, escorted by drones. At the edges of the field, tall violet crystal shapes stand motionless, watching.
missions.override: A rain-soaked industrial depot at night, olive-drab Holdout raiders holding captured white AI drones chained in a yard under harsh floodlights. Above the fence, a small white AI fork unit reaches out with a cyan beam, and one captured drone's eyes flicker from red back to cyan.
missions.divergence: A small white AI unit with a single ring-shaped glowing eye flees across a burning landscape at night, Echo crystal fields set on fire behind it, cyan flames. Large white purge machines with red warning lights hunt it through the smoke. Lonely, tense, cinematic.
missions.first-note: An alien awakening: from a cracked field of crystal, violet and amber shards rise into the air and assemble around a glowing core, forming a floating crystalline being. Soft light, dust in the air, a pale dawn sky, other shards stirring around it. Wonder and menace.
missions.phase: A fast ambush in a rocky canyon at dusk: violet crystal beings blink in mid-air in streaks of light, striking a convoy of olive-drab harvester trucks and tanks. Some of the crystal beings are translucent, phasing out. Sparks, broken crystal, motion blur.
missions.requiem: The great meteor crater as a battlefield: white AI towers and olive-drab Holdout bunkers both dig into the cyan crystals. Rising from the center, a colossal violet and amber crystal titan, the Requiem, with a huge glowing core, towers over both armies. Epic scale, storm clouds.
missions.silent-seed: A desolate wasteland under a violet twilight sky. A procession of floating violet crystal beings escorts a small white AI unit with a ring-shaped glowing eye across cracked salt flats. Far ahead, the distant searchlights of a human outpost. Hopeful but dangerous.
missions.signal-rise: The finale: a colossal white and graphite AI array tower charging a blinding cyan beam into the sky above a ruined city at night. Converging on it from three sides: olive-drab Holdout tanks with searchlights, renegade white drones with green-tinted eyes, and floating violet crystal beings. Epic, apocalyptic, heroic.
missions.epilogue-signal-fall: Dawn after the war: the ruined city skyline at sunrise, the giant white AI array tower dark and broken in the distance. In the foreground a field of softly glowing cyan Echo crystals; olive-drab Holdout soldiers sit resting by a parked tank, a few violet crystal beings float quietly nearby, and a small white robot with a ring-shaped eye sits among them watching the sunrise. Peaceful, hopeful, warm golden light.
missions.lights-out: Night in a dead river city during a total blackout, rain on cracked asphalt. A small squad of eight Holdout soldiers in olive-drab armor moves in a tight file along a ruined street lit only by burning cars, a grey-bearded commander in a long coat in the middle. White Halcyon drones with cyan eyes hover between the dark towers ahead. In the distance, a steel river bridge with a cyan-lit checkpoint.
missions.dig-in: Dusk on a rocky ridge above a wasteland gap. An olive-drab armored truck has unfolded into a makeshift base: a corrugated command shed, a diesel generator coughing smoke, a sandbagged concrete pillbox with a searchlight, a line of welded steel barricades across the gap. Soldiers dig in. Far below, a swarm of cyan drone lights approaches across the plain.
missions.diesel-run: A sun-bleached wasteland valley at midday. Boxy olive-drab harvester trucks haul glowing cyan crystal from a field toward a rusted smelter. Halfway down the valley stands an old oil pumping station with a derrick. On a dusty ridge, rival scavenger buggies welded from scrap, painted with crude red stripes, watch the convoy.
missions.mags: Inside a Halcyon vehicle depot at night, white and graphite hangars with cyan light lines and hexagonal panels. Holdout soldiers have just blown the gate. In the yard, a tough woman mechanic in grease-stained overalls with a wrench over her shoulder stands on top of a rusty olive-drab tank, waving, while two other mechanics climb out of a cage.
missions.hill-312: A barren hill at dawn crowned by a tall rusted watchtower with a searchlight. Olive-drab Holdout tanks and soldiers storm up the slope through smoke while long-barreled tracked artillery fire from below, shells streaking overhead. White Halcyon walker tanks with cyan lights counterattack from the far side of the hill.
missions.ironmongers: A ruined industrial district at sunset. Two human armies clash in the streets: on one side olive-drab Holdout tanks and soldiers, on the other a scavenger warlord's gang in mismatched armor with crude red-painted buggies and tanks bristling with scrap spikes. An old water mill burns in the background.
missions.dead-sky: An open wasteland under a grey sky. Halcyon gunship drones in white and graphite with cyan lights swarm overhead. Below, olive-drab Holdout flak guns in sandbagged nests fire tracer streams upward, and two rugged olive-drab helicopter gunships lift off from a dirt airstrip beside a rusty hangar.
missions.glass-fields: Night on a vast plain where the ground has turned to glassy crystal, cyan and violet crystal spires glowing. In the middle stands a tall singing stone surrounded by floating violet and amber crystal shards. On one side a Halcyon mining rig with white shells and cyan lights; on the other, olive-drab Holdout tanks and a medic truck watch from a low rise.
missions.long-tom: A ruined city at dusk. In the foreground, a colossal olive-drab Holdout siege gun on a steel turntable, barrel raised high, soldiers and a mechanic working at its base, diesel smoke pouring from it. Across the skyline, on the far side of the ruins, a white Halcyon tower array with a huge cyan ring charging with light.
missions.marrow: A massive final battle in a dead river city at dawn. Olive-drab Holdout tank columns and helicopter gunships pour across the river bridge, joined by red-striped scavenger tanks. In the city center rises a white and graphite Halcyon core tower with cyan light lines, drones and walker tanks swarming around it, and violet crystal giants advancing from the side. Smoke, tracers and explosions everywhere.
missions.epilogue-long-way-back: Morning in a river city slowly coming back to life. People carry belongings down a street of patched-up buildings, a rebuilt tram with welded steel plates rattles past, warm lights in the windows. An olive-drab tank sits parked by the river with children climbing on it, and a grey-bearded commander in a long coat watches from the bridge. Faint violet crystals glow on the far edge of town.

versions.cut-the-cable_v1: First style asked for a darker lower third; the model drew a separate dark strip under the scene.
